items.headline: Pearsall out for all of 2026 after PCL surgery
items.summary: GM John Lynch announced the receiver is having PCL surgery on his right knee and will not play this season. The knee swelled persistently through camp, carrying over an injury from last year. His target volume is now up for grabs across the rest of the receiver room.

items.summary: The receiver avoided opening camp on the PUP list as he recovers from the ACL he tore in Week 4 of 2025. He is tracking toward the opener against Dallas. His status had been the biggest question in the Giants offense all summer.
